facts.description: Excess kurtosis of 1s mid log-returns; Gaussian is 0, real assets are strongly positive.

facts.description: Autocorrelation of |returns| at lag 1: positive and persistent in real data.
facts.name: volatility_clustering_lag1

facts.description: Autocorrelation of |returns| at lag 10: decays slowly, staying above zero.
facts.name: volatility_clustering_lag10

facts.description: Autocorrelation of raw returns: near zero, slightly negative from bid-ask bounce.

facts.description: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio at 10s. Near 1 means the mid is close to a martingale; far below 1 would mean a market maker is paid by mean reversion rather than by providing liquidity.
facts.name: variance_ratio_10

facts.description: Variance ratio at 30s: the mid must stay diffusive at longer horizons too.
facts.name: variance_ratio_30

facts.description: Median quoted spread. The target regime is tick-constrained: mostly 1 tick.
facts.name: median_spread_ticks

facts.description: Mean resting volume at the touch. Must be large enough that queue position matters.
facts.name: mean_touch_depth_lots

facts.description: Hill tail index of order sizes; equity and futures data report roughly 1.5-2.5.
facts.name: order_size_tail_index

facts.description: Autocorrelation of market-order signs: real order flow is strongly persistent.
facts.name: market_order_sign_acf_lag1

facts.description: Index of the fullest level away from the touch; real books are hump-shaped.
facts.name: depth_profile_hump_index
